newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UOB to start asset management in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: UOB to start asset management in Malaysia.

text.p: The United Overseas Bank Group said on Saturday it will start joint venture fund management operations in Malaysia on Monday.
It said in a statement that UOB-OSK Asset Management Sdn Bhd was a venture between UOB Asset Management Ltd (UOBAM) and O.S.K. Holdings Bhd, a Kuala Lumpur-listed stockbroking house.
UOBAM holds a 70 percent stake in the venture, while O.S.K Holdings has 30 percent equity.
UOB-OSK will apply to be among the ten joint-venture foreign fund companies to be licenced by the Malaysian Securities Commission to manage domestic unit trust funds, it said.
